```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

# Create quantum and classical registers
q = QuantumRegister(3)
c = ClassicalRegister(3)

# Create quantum circuit
teleport = QuantumCircuit(q, c)

# Initialize q0 with X
teleport.x(q[0])

# Create a Bell pair on q1 and q2 with H and CX
teleport.h(q[1])
teleport.barrier()
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])

teleport.barrier()

# Apply Alice’s CX(q0,q1) and H(q0)
teleport.cx(q[0], q[1])
teleport.h(q[0])

# Measure q0 and q1 into c0 and c1
teleport.measure(q[0], c[0])
teleport.measure(q[1], c[1])

teleport.barrier()

# Apply CX(q1,q2) and CZ(q0,q2)
teleport.cx(q[1], q[2])
teleport.cz(q[0], q[2])

teleport.barrier()

# Measure q2 into c2
teleport.measure(q[2], c[2])

print(teleport.draw())
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np
import math

# Define the number of data qubits
n = 3

# Create a QuantumCircuit with n+1 qubits and n classical bits
qc = QuantumCircuit(QuantumRegister(n+1), ClassicalRegister(n))

# Flip the ancilla to |1>
qc.x(n)

# Add a barrier
qc.barrier()

# Apply Hadamards to all qubits
for i in range(n+1):
    qc.h(i)

# Add another barrier
qc.barrier()

print(qc.draw())
```

```python
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 1)

# Encode qubit 0 onto qubits 1 and 2
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.cx(0, 2)

# Apply Hadamards to all three qubits
qc.h([0, 1, 2])

# Insert a Z error on qubit 0
qc.x(0)
qc.z(0)
qc.x(0)

# Apply Hadamards again
qc.h([0, 1, 2])

# Decode with the same two CNOTs
qc.cx(1, 0)
qc.cx(2, 0)

# Correct with a Toffoli using qubits 2 and 1 as controls on qubit 0
qc.ccx(2, 1, 0)

# Measure qubit 0 into classical bit 0
qc.measure([0], [0])
```
